page.overview:
What is Realm?

Realms are dimensions of predetermined size, usually occupied by an only single world. Each realm exists on a separate plane of reality, allowing for a diverse variety of biological and sociological configurations. The thunder god Raiden states that all realms are in a constant state of flux, shifting like endless dreams.

The realms were created by the Elder Gods, who did so after splitting the One Being through the use of the Kamidogu. Despite its separation, the One Being would subtly influence the inhabitants of the realms, hoping to re-merge back into its true form, having mostly used rulers of Outworld as proxies to merge the realms back together.

When in some of these realms, Raiden's godly powers are weakened significantly.

Mortal Kombat: Deception established six realms: Earthrealm (aka Earth), Outworld, Netherrealm (aka Hell), Edenia (aka Eden), Chaosrealm, and Orderrealm (aka Seido).
